lead_raw_text:
The structure of Y₄Al₄Bi₄ (reduced formula YAlBi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors, Bi centers with 9 neighbors, and Y centers with 16 neighbors, showing a three-dimensional periodic neighbor graph. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner and edge sharing between Al and Bi polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing between Bi and Y polyhedra.
